text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...What's this now...
It ain't even cold, but I'm startin' to shiver...

Yukino Bijin is indeed trembling faintly,
but the look on her face doesn't seem to be nervousness.
choice_data_list: Looks like you've got plenty of motivation.
Looks like you've got plenty of motivation.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Spirit...? I see, so this is what they call trembling with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Just like you said, Trainer, my desire to win is so strong that my heart's pounding like crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, y'all keep your eyes glued on me!
I'm gonna run so fast, folks'll be sayin',
"Well ain't that just mighty amazin'!"
